bio: I'm responsible for housing all Kirkland students, managing the house budget, and most of the administrative processes for the house. I enjoy graphic design and am proficient in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator. On sunny days I spend my time with a sketchbook or a camera, on rainy days I hang out with my Kitchenaid mixer. The result is an overabundance of cake pans and art supplies in my apartment. I've worked at Harvard since August 2018, previously I worked at Simmons College and the University of Tulsa.
